desc: Mail from the second screen's Start menu (TTYD_COMPANION_WINDOW, the Items tab): its opening asks for the Mailbox SP and the game adds it, as its own Start menu's opening does; a letter received (mail 1) and read there: the game marks it read and sets the first-letter flag (pouchOpenMail, GSWF 38) at the point its own menu could open
log_must: \[companion\] menu: the Mailbox SP asked for
\[companion\] the Mailbox SP: added to the pouch
